one_line: Early Gurjara-Pratihara ruler who helped stem Arab frontier raids in western India in the 8th century.

appearance.age_look: Mid-30s, athletic and wiry, with the solid build of a mounted warrior used to campaigning in arid plains.
appearance.face: Oval face with a straight nose, dusky wheat-brown complexion, sharp dark eyes under slightly arched brows, neatly trimmed moustache with a short close beard along the jaw; default expression is calm, watchful determination with a hint of stern resolve.
appearance.hair: Thick black hair parted in the middle, drawn back into a low, tight knot at the nape of the neck, wrapped with a narrow red cloth band; no crown, but a plain narrow copper-bronze circlet resting above the forehead, simple and unjeweled.
appearance.costume: He wears a long-sleeved knee-length angarkha-style tunic in muted saffron cloth that wraps left over right and ties with inner and outer cloth ties, the edges bordered with a narrow dark-red woven band; beneath, close-fitting off‑white cotton churidar-style trousers bunch slightly at the ankles; over the tunic, he has a sleeveless, slightly quilted dark‑brown leather-covered cotton vamsha-style vest fitted to the torso, stitched in vertical channels to suggest padding, historically plausible as protective wear; around his waist a broad, dark‑red cotton sash (katisutra) is tightly wound several times and knotted on his left hip, from which hangs a small leather pouch; he wears a simple, rectangular off‑white cotton uttariya (shawl) draped from the left shoulder across the chest and tucked at the waist, with a thin brown border; his feet are in sturdy brown leather boots rising just above the ankle with simple stitching, suitable for riding; jewellery is minimal and practical: small plain bronze ear studs, a single black-and-bronze bead mala around his neck, and a simple bronze armlet on his right upper arm; overall textiles look hand‑woven, matte, with subtle unevenness rather than shiny luxury.
appearance.signature: A straight, slightly broad-bladed iron sword in a plain dark-brown leather scabbard: the hilt has a gently flared crossguard and a rounded pommel wrapped in dark-red cord, carried suspended from his waist sash on a simple leather belt so the grip rests near his left hand.

ref_desc: Nagabhata I is a mid-30s dusky warrior with an oval face, short beard, black hair tied in a low knot with a red band, wearing a saffron angarkha, off-white trousers, quilted dark-brown vest, red sash, ankle boots, bronze circlet, and a plain leather-sheathed iron sword at his waist in muted saffron, dark red, off-white, dark brown and bronze tones.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character sheet of Nagabhata I, a mid-30s early medieval Indian frontier ruler from Rajasthan and Malwa: he has an oval face, wheat-brown complexion, sharp dark eyes, a neatly trimmed moustache and short beard along the jaw, and thick black hair parted in the middle and tied into a low knot at the nape of the neck with a narrow red cloth band; a simple narrow bronze circlet rests above his forehead. He wears a long-sleeved knee-length saffron angarkha-style tunic that wraps left over right with narrow dark-red edging, close-fitting off-white churidar trousers, and a sleeveless, slightly quilted dark-brown leather-covered cotton vest with vertical stitching, fitted to the torso. A broad dark-red cotton sash is tightly wound around his waist and knotted on his left hip, supporting a small leather pouch, and an off-white cotton uttariya shawl with a thin brown border is draped from his left shoulder across his chest and tucked into the sash. His footwear is sturdy brown leather ankle boots suitable for riding. Jewellery is minimal: small plain bronze ear studs, a single black-and-bronze bead mala, and a simple bronze armlet on his right upper arm. His signature weapon is a straight iron sword in a plain dark-brown leather scabbard, with a slightly flared crossguard and rounded pommel wrapped in dark-red cord, hanging from a simple belt so the hilt sits by his left hand. Use a restrained palette of muted saffron, dark red, off-white, dark brown and bronze, and present him in neutral poses that clearly show his face, hair, clothing details, and sword from multiple angles without any text.
